conviction_note: A full-year raise at this H1 print is likely: Q1 operating profit of 413m was already 37.5% of the 1,100m plan that was raised in July, the plan implies only about 229m a quarter for Q2-Q4, and the company raised at each of its last three prints (25/10, 26/01, 26/07), with +10-15% reactions each time. But kabutan named TESEC as an upward-revision candidate on 10-25, and the stock rose 6.9% on 10-26 on twice its usual volume against a falling sector. So the revision is partly priced: p_up 60 on an abs move of 7 gives +1.4. The findings sum to +1.9 on their own sizes; the gap is the probability weighting, not a second haircut.
bar: Company full-year plan FY2027/3, revised 2026-07-28: sales 7,000m, OP 1,100m, ordinary 1,300m, net 1,040m, DPS 100 (50 interim). No H1 forecast, no analyst consensus (kabuyoho shows none) and no 四季報 number found. Sources: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260728500708.pdf and https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6337. Because the bar is a company plan and not a street number, sizes are kept moderate.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, as of 2026-10-26, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). The baseline's 信用倍率 of 1,103x is STRUCTURAL rather than a crowded long: kabutan lists 6337 as a 制度信用 name where only margin buying is allowed (買建のみ, not a 貸借銘柄), so margin shorts are close to impossible (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6337, 2026-10-27). The baseline's margin_overhang component (-1.52) is therefore largely an artefact. The last margin-long level I could read was 215,100 shares on 2026-07-17, about 3.9% of 5.58m shares (https://irbank.net/6337/margin); recent weeks are not on the free page. There is no skew in this market. Run-up: 20d -3.6%, 5d +7.6%. The stock went from 4,140 on 10-09 to 3,040 on 10-23, which was sector-driven (Advantest -15.0% on 10-15), then rose +6.9% on 10-26 against a falling sector, and was +6.6% at 10:13 on 10-27 alongside a sector rally (Advantest +10%).

findings.finding: The company is likely to raise its full-year forecast at this H1 print. Q1 OP of 413m is 37.5% of the July-raised 1,100m plan (ordinary 517m, 39.8% of 1,300m), and the plan implies only about 229m a quarter for Q2-Q4. Q1 orders were 2,012m (+116% YoY; handlers 1,232m, +191%) and the backlog was 2,655m, up 4% from FY-end, on MAP-handler demand tied to AI. The company has raised at each of its last three prints. The Q2 FX assumption is neutral: USD/JPY averaged 159.3 for Jul-Sep against the 160 assumed. Sized net of the 10-26 pre-print rise that partly prices the expectation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Upward FY revisions on 2025-10-28 (ordinary 2.2x): +10.56% in the baseline window, four straight up days. 2026-01-27 (+61%, with a buyback): +11.31%. 2026-07-28 (ordinary 2.2x): +14.5% in the baseline window, then limit-up on 07-31. Every revision this name has made in the last year was bought hard.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. kabutan's 2026-10-25 '今週の上方修正【大予想】' list named TESEC (it raised ordinary profit at H1 in 3 of the last 5 years), and the stock rose 6.9% on 10-26 on 184k shares (about 2-3x normal) while Advantest fell 3.9%. That is why this finding is +1.5 and not the +10% of prior revisions. What is not priced is the SIZE: the stock (3,465) sits 16% below its 10-09 high of 4,140 after a sector sell-off, so the price does not reflect a second large raise. A raise that only matches the run-in would show the stock already back at 4,000+.
findings.independence: The company's own track record is the revision table on https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6337 (the 25/10/28, 26/01/27 and 26/07/28 revisions). The third-party expectation is kabutan's 10-25 article https://kabutan.jp/news/marketnews/?b=n202610250063. Both are separate documents from the 短信, but the Q1 progress rate is one fact, counted once here.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns: the 2026-05-26 buyback (cap 150k shares or 300m yen) was fully used, 99,800 shares for 299.7m, and ended 2026-09-18. The company says it buys back 'flexibly' (機動的) and has authorised new programmes at the Jan-2026 Q3 print and in May 2026, so a renewal announced with H1 is plausible but not established. The H1 dividend of 50 yen is fixed under a DOE-4% policy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-05-26 buyback announcement: kabutan '急反発' and '大幅反発' on 05-27. 2026-01-27 revision plus buyback: +11.31% (combined with the revision).
findings.why_not_priced: No authorisation is outstanding, so nothing is in the price. A new one would land in a retail-heavy, buy-only margin register. It is an inference from cadence, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The policy statement 'business-cycle-balanced, 機動的 buybacks' is on slide 11 of https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260728500726.pdf. The May-2026 announcement is reported at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6337&b=n202605260867.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: likely upward (Q1 OP progress 37.5%; three consecutive raises), flagged publicly by kabutan, so partly priced. Returns: the buyback programme is completed and a renewal is possible; the dividend is fixed at 50/100 under DOE 4%. New-year guide: n/a (H1 print). Quarter vs own progress history: Q1 ordinary progress 39.8% against 3.8% (FY26) and about 70% of H1 in FY25, so it is far ahead of this company's own pattern. FY26's H1 ordinary was 60.8% of that year's plan.

baseline_tension: Cuts against the baseline's negative lean (-1.34), but most of that lean is the margin_overhang term built on a 1,103x 信用倍率 that is structural for a buy-only margin name, not evidence of a crowded long. The 20d run-up (-3.6%) is sector-driven and the 5d run-in (+7.6%) partly prices the revision. The strongest positive the release can carry, an upward FY revision plus a new buyback, is what the findings are about. The main downside is a held plan (Q1 had one-off high-margin projects) against an expectation kabutan has publicized, which is what keeps p_up at 60 rather than higher.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: both LESSONS rules concern negatives that rest on public 月次/進捗率 misses, and this call is positive. Open question 4 (a 5-day run-in is not a short signal) agrees with treating the 10-26 run-in as a one-time size reduction on finding 1, not as a separate negative finding.
